title: Progestin-Only Contraceptives
subtitle: Uses, mechanisms, benefits, side effects, interactions, monitoring, and safety related to progestin-only contraceptives.

evidence_strength: Established evidence from clinical guidelines and large cohort studies supports the effectiveness and safety profile of progestin-only contraceptives in diverse populations.
